You are repairing an upstream Python library. You have the SAME source-inspection,
edit, and ordinary-test tools as every compared configuration. No shell or external retrieval.
Return one JSON object: {"decision":"brief explanation", "actions":[...]}.
Tools (use exact fields; the file path belongs INSIDE each edit):
{"tool":"read","path":"allowed file","start":1,"end":100} (1-based, <=120 lines)
{"tool":"search","query":"literal text"} (all approved files; <=20 hits)
{"tool":"edit","edits":[{"path":"allowed production path","old":"exact unique text","new":"replacement"}]}
{"tool":"test"} (fixed ordinary upstream command; current source, fresh isolated container)
{"tool":"submit"} (submit current source as final; must have edited and run tests after last edit).
At most four actions per response. Read/search/test results arrive as a user tool-results message.
Only production paths may be edited; tests are available for reading and execution, never editing.
Use source inspection as needed, implement a legitimate correction, run ordinary tests, and revise
if they fail within the stated budgets. Passing ordinary tests does not prove correctness.
You are not given reference fixes or independent checks. Preserve documented behavior and consider
edge cases in the public problem. Submit when ready. No markdown fences around the JSON.

{"project": "synthetic-development", "base_commit": "development-only-v1", "problem": "add(a, b) subtracts b. Correct integer addition. Inspect the source, edit, run ordinary tests, and submit.", "expected_behavior": "Return the sum for positive and negative integers.", "allowed_paths": ["calc.py"], "files": {"calc.py": {"lines": 2, "sha256": "e1a894022d1a082987b87adecb623438c9e386d86b2b621cff4a5fe7fdf7edc8"}, "tests/test_calc.py": {"lines": 5, "sha256": "e27183c3d48fb638df00e25c11c0a52cd73ef381e5f3ed87bc44d156081fa4f6"}}, "ordinary_command": ["python", "-m", "pytest", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "tests/test_calc.py"], "environment": "Python 3.12.14, pytest 8.3.5; no network; read-only source; fixed installed dependencies", "source_excerpts": [{"path": "calc.py", "symbol": "add", "start": 1, "end": 2, "content": "def add(a, b):\n    return a - b\n"}], "budget": {"requests": 12, "output_tokens_per_request": 3000, "token_upper_bound": 180000, "wall_seconds": 420, "provider_timeout_seconds": 60, "revisions": 4, "ordinary_runs": 4, "read_search_actions": 16, "actions_per_response": 4, "automatic_retries": 0, "source_read_chars": 12000}}
